services.desc: Welcome to long-term RV living at Strawberry Park! If you’re looking for a comfortable setup with a great community in southeastern Connecticut, you’ve landed in the right place. Choose a long-term full hookup site, reserve a seasonal spot, or explore our lease-to-own and for-sale lots for a path toward making Strawberry Park your go-to getaway each year. We’re really proud of the community at Strawberry Park. Long-term guests are a big part of what makes this place feel so welcoming and that’s exactly why we built this place with monthly and seasonal living in mind. services.name: Cabins
services.desc: Ever dreamed of spending the night in a log cabin? With eight cozy cabin rentals on property, we can make that happen! These humble abodes offer an easy way to enjoy campground life with a few extra comforts built in. Spend your days at the pools, participating in onsite activities, or exploring nearby attractions, then come back to your own space to relax. We can’t wait to host you. Our eight log cabins give you that classic cabin feel, with the comforts that make a trip just a little easier. Inside, each cabin includes a kitchen and bathroom, A/C, and a living area with a pullout sofa. services.desc: Premium Rental Trailer - Our Premium Rental Trailers offer a cozy setup, just a bit smaller than our park models. Each trailer has two bedrooms, including a queen bed in one room and twin bunk beds in the other, plus a living room with a full-size pullout sofa for extra sleeping space. Deluxe Rental Trailer - Our Deluxe Rental Trailers are our most budget-friendly option with the same basic layout as the park models, just in a slightly older, smaller unit. Inside, you’ll find two bedrooms with a queen bed and twin bunk beds, along with a living room that includes a full-size pullout sofa.
